definitions.gloss: closing in on; pressing hard; approaching closely
definitions.explanation: To draw very close to a competitor, target, or enemy, either physically or figuratively. Often used in competitive contexts to describe nearly catching up or closing a gap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二位|にい}→二位：27466_nii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The second-place team is closing in on first place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{陣地|じんち}→陣地：30721_jinchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They pressed close to the enemy's position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the election, the opposition candidate came very close to the ruling party's candidate.

notes:
{肉薄|にくはく} literally means "flesh-thin," conveying the image of being so close that only a thin layer remains between two parties.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [target]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (close in on a target)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (close in on first place)
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (press close to the enemy)
- ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉薄|にくはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (get close to the truth)

Originally a military term describing troops approaching the enemy at close range. Now widely used in sports, elections, and journalism to describe a close contest or a pursuit that is nearly successful.
